title: About
body:
We design immersive, game-based, and interactive experiences that help people learn from and participate in the world around them, across archaeological sites, museums, cities, classrooms, and virtual worlds, with a shared commitment to making those experiences situated, participatory, and accessible.

We come from anthropology, informatics, architecture, historic preservation, game studies, extended reality, artificial intelligence, learning sciences, and accessibility. We share one question: how do the physical, cultural, social, and technological contexts people are placed in shape what they understand and how they belong?

VR, XR, and AI are means to that end, not ends in themselves.
